done_when: On a runner without gh, the nightly full-test result step sets up Python, posts the forge-full-suite status with Python's standard library, reads the token from the environment, and passes or fails to match the full run.

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Test. The repaired test still supplies Python independently of the workflow and checks only that the setup step precedes the reporter. If setup is conditioned on `needs.full-suite.result == 'success'`, the test passes for both outcomes, but a failed run on a runner without Python or gh cannot post its failure status. The assertion also still rejects a behavior-preserving implementation that uses checkout, as noted in the previous review.
Case: normal use - A nightly full run fails on a fresh runner without gh or preinstalled Python.
findings.title: Gate: test_3_full_test_result_is_posted_without_gh

stop.reason: Owner's standing choice for 11 Nov 2026: one more round for a test point

why: Bug 1524. On a self-hosted or new-each-job runner without the GitHub command-line tool (gh), the nightly full-test result step fails, so the full-suite status is never posted.
